recap.text: Carl provokes a chat show, and the Skull Empire sends a pulse from Prince Stalwart's yacht. The pulse hits Manasa's trailer instead of Carl's. The Valtay destroy the yacht, and three funerals follow.

Maggie My holds a celestial grenade that summons a god for sixty seconds and wraps the holder in Divine Intervention. Prince Maestro and Crown Prince Stalwart sent Maggie a scroll to choose a god and Chris a box with a picture of Algos. Mordecai calls this a bribed one-on-one in a saferoom and identifies Algos as the god of pain who would kill everyone in town in seconds.

The Skull Empire and the Hive stake claims on Carl and Donut using a dead hunter's map. Future Huntress, a level 50 Boring Ol' Fighter with high charisma, survives an ambush near an all-tree after a Talent zaps himself dead with a Lightning scroll. Carl shows a photo of Queen Consort Ugloo to the orcs, and the Skull Empire votes with Carl and Donut to turn off the sponsors' safety protocols.

Princess Formidable of the Skull Empire demands the Syndicate Council blow the star to wipe the system off the map before the AI infects the center system. Prime Minister Glory counts the galaxy's wealth trapped in the system. The mantid representative proposes a decorum sanction, and by 86%, Princess Formidable is muted.

King Rust leads an army of orcs in battle parade regalia to the edge of camp. The Posse closes the saferoom door before a bomb can be dropped through it. Rust offers a retreat if Carl sends a message to Princess Formidable, who stole a warship to trip the Failsafe by hand and told the Syndicate about secret back doors. Rosetta hits Rust with a whip as he rides away, and the army charges.

Zev tells the teams that Odette's husband, Harry Tisch, bought the rights to every show Donut mentioned to keep the orcs solvent. King Rust vetoed Tisch's extradition for tax fraud. In the Makoka Cloud, the Skull Empire swallows real estate holdings and triples Sydnee Iglacia's rent, removing oxygen from the cost.

beats.headline: Carl plants a seed on Danger Zone
beats.text: A few minutes of provocation on a chat show, and the Skull Empire answers them with a pulse from Prince Stalwart's yacht. It hits Manasa's trailer instead of Carl's, which was a mistake, and the Valtay answer that in turn by destroying the yacht, with his mother and the Maestro rumoured to be aboard. Three funerals come of it.
beats.gist: Carl provokes a chat show, and the Skull Empire pulses Prince Stalwart's yacht at Manasa's trailer.

beats.headline: Algos, by celestial grenade
beats.text: The ball in Maggie My's hand is a celestial grenade: it summons the holder's god for sixty seconds and wraps the holder in Divine Intervention. Through Chris, relayed by Elle, comes where it came from. Maggie's sponsors are Prince Maestro and Crown Prince Stalwart, and so are Chris's. They sent her a scroll to choose a god, and Chris a box with a picture of Algos on it, so she knew which. Mordecai reads it as unofficial, a bribed one-on-one in a saferoom, and Algos as the god of pain: he would kill everyone in town in seconds.
beats.gist: Maggie My holds a celestial grenade that summons Algos, the god of pain, for sixty seconds.

beats.headline: A claim staked on the hunters' map
beats.text: The map off the dead hunter divides the hunting grounds between the outfits working them, and two of those outfits have put a claim on Carl and Donut. The Hive is one. The Skull Empire is the other.
beats.gist: The Hive and the Skull Empire stake claims on Carl and Donut on the hunters' map.

beats.headline: Future Huntress
beats.text: Three of the Skull Empire's hunters try an ambush near an outcropping of the all-tree, which turns spells back on their casters. The Talent zaps himself dead with his own Lightning scroll, carrying almost 75,000 gold and a credit chit. The survivor is Future Huntress, level 50, a Boring Ol' Fighter who has not levelled once. She says top tens are fair game for anyone who bought the hunting license, that the empire paid for first crack at Carl, and that her death leaves him to the Dark Hive. Her highest stat is charisma.
beats.gist: Three Skull Empire hunters ambush Carl; one zaps himself dead with a Lightning scroll.

beats.headline: The orcs vote yes
beats.text: Carl holds up a photo of the late Queen Consort Ugloo, mother of the Maestro and Prince Stalwart, killed when the Valtay blew up her yacht after the orcs accidentally killed a singer. The vote to turn off the sponsors' safety protocols stands at two to seven, and the two are Carl and Donut's new team and the Skull Empire. The orcs are crazy and they're all going to die, Carl tells the cameras, but they're not chickens.
beats.gist: Carl holds up a photo of Queen Consort Ugloo to the Skull Empire.

beats.headline: Muted for proposing the failsafe
beats.text: At an emergency session of the Syndicate Council, Princess Formidable of the Skull Empire demands the failsafe: blow the star and wipe the system off the map, before the AI can infect the center system. She is in orbit herself, and says so. Accused of wanting her father and brothers dead, she admits she would love them deposed, and insists that this is bigger. Prime Minister Glory counts the galaxy's wealth trapped in the system and the wars it would start. The mantid representative proposes a decorum sanction. By 86%, she is muted.
beats.gist: Princess Formidable proposes blowing the star to stop the AI, but the Syndicate Council mutes her.

beats.headline: King Rust at the wall
beats.text: The enemy's northern army masses at the edge of camp, and riding in at the head of the orcs, in full battle parade regalia, is the king himself. The Posse closes off the saferoom before anybody can drop a bomb through its door. Rust asks for an official parlay.
beats.gist: King Rust leads the northern army of orcs to camp and asks the Posse for a parlay.

beats.headline: The parlay, and what his daughter told the Syndicate
beats.text: Rust explains it himself. Princess Formidable has commandeered one of his own warships and announced that she means to trip the Failsafe by hand. She has also told the Syndicate that the empire builds secret back doors into the security systems it sells. He asks Carl to send her a message on behalf of the people of Earth and trades a retreat for it. Rosetta takes his head off with a whip as he rides away, and the army charges.
beats.gist: Rust tells Carl that Princess Formidable took a warship to trip the Failsafe by hand.

beats.headline: Zev's aside, and Rosetta on Harry Tisch
beats.text: While the teams build their floats, Zev mentions in passing that Odette's husband has bought the rights to every show Donut has ever mentioned, and that it is probably all that is keeping the orcs solvent. Rosetta supplies the rest: his name is Harry Tisch, King Rust vetoed his extradition for tax fraud, and he has been working himself deeper into the empire ever since. Empires that sell weapons still have to bank somewhere.
beats.gist: Zev and Rosetta explain that Harry Tisch bought Donut's shows to keep the orcs solvent.

beats.headline: Rent, tripled
beats.text: With D'Nadia dead, whoever is running the Skull Empire in the royal family's absence has swallowed every real estate holding of a group the Prism controlled. In the Makoka Cloud, Sydnee Iglacia's rent triples starting the next crutch, and oxygen is no longer included. She curses the Skull Empire, the Valtay and D'Nadia in the same breath.
beats.gist: The Skull Empire swallows Prism real estate and triples Sydnee Iglacia's rent in the Makoka Cloud.

relations.note: A formal truce with the Bone Clan
